artworks.title: Marsh Weeds
artworks.medium: photogravure on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harvey S. Shipley Miller and J. Randall Plummer, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a snowy landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. Snow dominates the scene, with a line of trees and a wooden fence near the horizon. Snow-covered rooftops of houses are visible beyond the fence. In the foreground, dark silhouettes of plants emerge from the snow. The style is soft focus, possibly photographic, creating a calm and quiet impression. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of white and gray enhancing the wintry ambiance.

artworks.title: Rime Crystals
artworks.medium: photogravure on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harvey S. Shipley Miller and J. Randall Plummer, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a wetland or marsh landscape. The horizon is low with tall grasses or reeds separating the water and the sky. In the distance, a structure, possibly a hut, is partially visible behind vegetation. The water reflects the sky, hinting at either dawn or dusk. The sky above has a soft, diffuse quality blending with the muted tones of the scene. The overall atmosphere is serene, with smooth transitions between textures and tones contributing to a calm scene.

artworks.title: The Last Gate
artworks.medium: photogravure on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harvey S. Shipley Miller and J. Randall Plummer, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person next to a wooden fence or gate. The person is wearing a light-colored shirt and dark trousers, standing to the left and facing away while handling the gate. The sky occupies most of the upper part of the image with a solitary tree on the left side. The painting style is smooth and soft, with a monochromatic sepia color palette creating a nostalgic and serene rural scene.

artworks.title: Study for a Prophet
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on laid paper; squared for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Yvonne tan Bunzl, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a seated, muscular person with one arm raised above the head and the other arm holding a tablet or board on the lap. The person's head is turned to the side, with a face displaying soft, relaxed features. The hair is closely cropped, and there is drapery covering the lower body. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects. The background consists of a grid.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck and Jacobus Neeffs
artworks.medium: etching and engraving (etching of head by  van Dyck and finished in engraving by J. Neeffs) on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the upper body of a man facing slightly to his right while looking over his left shoulder towards the viewer. The man has a pointed mustache, a well-defined nose, and curly hair. He is clad in a garment with a high collar and is not holding any objects. Below him is a carved pedestal with classical motifs, two helmeted figures on each side, and a central shield adorned with decorative elements. The background consists of engraved clouds that blend with the figure's hair. The name "ANT. VAN DYCK" is inscribed above the central shield on the pedestal.

artworks.title: Jodocus de Momper
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up. They are angled to the side, with their head turned towards the viewer. The individual has a mustache, short beard, and gray, wavy hair. Their facial features include a prominent nose and deep-set eyes. The person is wearing a loose garment with elaborate folds and a high, ruffled collar. They are holding a small object in their right hand. The background displays a landscape with mountains and a partly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Jan Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man's upper body. He faces forward with his head slightly turned to the left. He has a full beard, mustache, and short, wavy hair on top of his head. He wears a ruffled collar and a garment resembling a buttoned shirt. His right hand rests on his chest. The background is a simple, textured surface. The text identifies the man as "Ioannes Brevghel" and notes his profession related to the arts or painting.

artworks.title: Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This image depicts an upper-body portrait of a man seated with his body turned slightly to the side but his head facing forward. The man has a full head of wavy hair, a mustache, and a beard. He is dressed in a garment with a high lace collar and appears to be wearing a cloak. His right hand is raised to his chest, holding a quill pen. The background is a simple, textured backdrop. At the bottom of the image, there is text identifying the person as D. PETRVS PAVLVS RVBBENS Eques, with additional descriptions and information below.

artworks.title: Michel Miereveld
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. He is seated, facing slightly to his left with his head turned towards the viewer. The man appears older with facial features including a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, and receding curly hair. He is dressed in period clothing with a ruffled collar and a cloak. He holds a paintbrush in his hand. The background includes a large architectural column, hinting at a grand environment.

artworks.title: The Oval Fountain in the Gardens of the Villa d'Este, Tivoli
artworks.medium: red chalk over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Neil Phillips and Mr. and Mrs. Ivan Phillips, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art

artworks.title: The Prophets Hosea and Jonah
artworks.artist: Louis-Felix de La Rue after Raphael
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows three figures, two men and one angel, standing from head to toe. The first man on the left is holding a rectangular tablet and is slightly turned to the side. He has curly hair, a long beard, and detailed facial features. The second figure, an angel behind the men, has short, curly hair and raised arm. The third figure is seated on the right, leaning against a large tablet, with curly hair and a beard, and wearing a hooded robe. The background is simple, drawing focus to the figures.

artworks.title: Marie-Antoinette
artworks.artist: Marie Louise Adelaide Boizot after Louis-Simon Boizot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman's upper body, displayed in profile from the chest up. The woman is posed elegantly, looking to the right with delicate facial features, including a straight nose and a serene expression. Her hair is styled elaborately in curls with a ribbon-like accessory. She wears a patterned garment with a ruffled neckline. The portrait is set in an ornate oval frame adorned with floral garlands and bows. Below the portrait, a label reads "Marie Antoinette d'Autriche Reine de France." The background features a textured pattern.

artworks.title: A un peuple libre
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows multiple individuals engaged in various activities. There is a winged figure holding a banner that reads "AN 1ER DE LA REVOLUTION." Below, a sculpture of a bust rests on a pedestal. A group of people are gathered around the monument, with one holding a wreath. Their clothing resembles historic garments. Flags and another crowd are visible in the background, with a figure standing prominently and gesturing as if speaking to those around. The setting suggests a monumental area or a public space.

artworks.title: Louis XIII
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [first state]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a horse. He is upright, holding the reins with one hand and a long staff with the other. The man has wavy hair, a mustache, and a small pointed beard. He wears armor with engravings, a sash across his chest, and a laurel wreath on his head. The horse is mid-stride, with a flowing mane and tail. In the background, there is a vast landscape with distant mountains and tiny figures on horseback. A few clouds are visible in the sky.

artworks.title: Louis XIII
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [second state]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a man on horseback. He is seated upright on a rearing horse, holding the reins in one hand and a scepter in the other. The man has a mustache and medium-length wavy hair, wearing a laurel wreath and ornate armor. A sash drapes over one shoulder. The background includes a textured sky with clouds and a landscape with figures on horseback and hills or mountains. The illustration style suggests historical or classical influences.

artworks.title: Thirteen Studies of Heads
artworks.medium: etching in black on thin wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features sketches of several older men in different poses and perspectives. Each sketch focuses on specific facial features, hair styles, and clothing details. One man is holding a fur muff, and a large cross hangs in the top right corner. The background is a plain light-colored canvas.

artworks.title: Seven Studies of Heads
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This image is an etching showing seven bust-length portraits of individuals. The top left figure has closed eyes, smooth facial features, and long hair wrapped with a turban-like cloth. Next to them is an older man with a furrowed brow and strong facial lines, curly and receding hair. Below these figures, in the middle row to the left is an older man with a large, fluffy fur hat and a full beard, while on the right is a middle-aged man donning a wide-brimmed hat, long hair peeking beneath it, and distinctive facial creases. The bottom row shows an elderly bearded man with closed eyes, another elderly man in a tall cylindrical fur hat with long hair and a substantial beard, and another elderly man with his head turned to the left, also wearing a tall fur-collared coat or garment. The background is a plain, lightly sketched surface.

artworks.title: A Donkey by a Water Well
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This drawing depicts two donkeys near a stone structure, surrounded by trees and plants. One donkey is lying down while the other is standing. The scene includes detailed foliage, shadows, distant figures, and animals. The drawing emphasizes the textures of the fur, leaves, and stonework with intricate line work.

artworks.title: Two Cows and a Woman Lying Down
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 7.1 x 18.5 cm (2 13/16 x 7 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman resting under a tree with two cows and a small dog nearby. In the background, there are hills, cows grazing, and a rustic wooden fence. The artwork is intricate with fine lines detailing textures. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Les Pêcheurs (The Fishermen)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 32.2 × 23.2 cm (12 11/16 × 9 1/8 in.)
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 34.2 × 24.2 cm (13 7/16 × 9 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a slightly elevated perspective. Both the foreground and background are visible, with a low horizon that includes a tall tower with a conical roof. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the foliage and textures of the structures. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia tones. In the foreground, two figures are by a boat near trees, potentially fishermen. The background features rustic wooden buildings. The sky has clouds painted with soft, sweeping brushstrokes.

artworks.title: Rococo Fountain with Lovers and the Four Elements
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a decorative fountain with multiple figures and ornate details. At the top of the fountain, a figure stands with outstretched arms, likely a cherub or playful child, crowning the structure. Below, a woman is seated in a relaxed pose against a backdrop of foliage, intricately carved into the recess of the fountain. On either side, two cherub-like figures are engaged in activities; one is holding a stick, and the other is playing with an object. The fountain's basin has a central spout resembling a masked face that seemingly pours water, while below this, there's a relief of a woman's face with flowing hair. The fountain is depicted in shades of gray and black, indicative of a stone or plaster material, and is elaborately detailed with intricate carvings and floral motifs.

artworks.title: Torione Anticho Fori di Roma
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jean and Kahlil Gibran
artworks.description: This image features a cylindrical tower rising above lush foliage. The tower is slightly to the right of center, surrounded by soft, blurred lines that suggest vegetation. There is no clearly defined horizon, as the landscape's contours blend into the background. The artwork is executed in a monochromatic palette dominated by reddish-brown tones. The strokes are loose and gestural, creating a sense of movement in the trees. The elements merge into one another to create a harmonious composition.

artworks.title: The Vaccine
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dora Donner Ide in memory of William Henry Donner and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a room, engaging with each other. An older man is sitting at the center-right, with a young child on the lap of a woman beside him. Another woman is bending over to interact with a toddler. Various children in 19th-century attire are around them. The room features a closed door, wood paneling, draped curtains, and a small dog. Another woman, holding a baby, is on the left. The drawing is monochrome, highlighting details of clothing and the room.

artworks.title: A Stand of Cypresses in an Italian Park
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, a low horizon line, a statue or structure in the distance, a fine linear style, warm sepia tones, and a sky with soft clouds.
